title: WorkerEventLine
description: Schema for ONE NDJSON line of POST /v1/runs/{runId}/events (Content-Type: application/x-ndjson). The endpoint accepts up to 200 lines or 512 KiB total per request. See worker-protocol spec: 'Event stream upload via NDJSON'.

kind.description: Event category. Frozen — additions require v2.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload. Schema is open here; per-kind shapes are documented in cloud/src/workerproto/v1/event-payloads.ts.

seq.description: Monotonic per-run sequence number assigned by the worker. Optional but recommended for replay deduplication.

Limits.description: Server-enforced limits (informational; not part of wire payload).
